example_comments: One factor that was kinda glossed over is the tamp strength. The instructions recommend "20-30 pounds" of pressure on the tamper, but I have no idea what that translates to. I've tried pressing hard, pressing lightly, all with varying degrees of success. I can get a total extraction time of 21-24 sec, which is in the ballpark, but only about 35ml of coffee comes out for a double shot. Is that unusually low? When I try it without grounds, about 80ml of water comes out, which sounds closer to normal. Should I reprogram the machine to pump out more water? My coffee has crema, but it's not very thick.
